title: isohyps machine index
description: Public, versioned machine_index.json contract. The current producer emits v2 with structured attention; v1 remains readable through the version-aware runtime API.

schema_version.description: Decimal major.minor version string. The initial producer version is 1.0; major changes are not backward compatible.

files.description: File entries sorted by their repository-relative POSIX path. Path uniqueness and ordering are checked by the runtime contract validator.

dependency_graph.description: Mapping from a source file to its direct internal dependencies. Keys and adjacency arrays are sorted by path; graph consistency is checked by the runtime contract validator.

dependency_order.description: Dependency-first path order. Acyclic edges place dependencies before dependents; cycle fallback ordering is deterministic but is not a strict topological order.

repositoryRelativePath.description: Normalized repository-relative POSIX path. Absolute paths, Windows drive paths, backslashes, NULs, empty segments, and '.' or '..' segments are invalid.

path.description: Stable file identity relative to the scan root.

hash.description: Lowercase SHA-256 content digest for readable text, or the existing binary_skipped/error sentinel.

size.description: File size in bytes at scan time.

language.description: Value returned by the existing language detector; unknown is used when no language is detected.

public_symbols.description: Public symbols in the existing classes-then-functions extraction order.

internal_symbols.description: Internal symbols in the existing classes-then-functions extraction order.

fan_in.description: Number of direct incoming dependency edges.

fan_out.description: Number of direct dependencies listed for this file.
